references.text: The first census of the tribe of Manasseh, which counted 32,200 men. Comparison shows the tribe's growth during the wilderness journey.
The preceding verses that list the clans of Manasseh summarized in this verse.
Jacob's blessing over Manasseh, where he prophesied that Manasseh would become a great people.
The allocation of land to the tribe of Manasseh, based on the census in Numbers 26.
Manasseh's birth as Joseph's firstborn son in Egypt, the origin of the tribe.
Machir's children (Manasseh's son) were born on Joseph's knees, showing the tribe's early growth.
